message.content: {"count":4,"rationale":"Blocking vaultRead:collection, codeRepo:collection, shareMount:collection, and dbReplica:collection blocks every parent of the target, so four blocks suffice. Four are necessary because there are four attack derivations with disjoint blockable steps: (1) containerHost → configSecret → printServer → codeRepo; (2) workstation → kerberoast → backupHost → shareMount; (3) mailClient and browserStore → rdpLogin → monitoringHost → dbReplica; (4) dmzWeb and ciRunner → vpnSession, together with sshKey → jumpHost, then serviceAccount → vaultRead. Each derivation is supported by entry footholds and respects the AND dependencies. Since the derivations share no blockable steps, each requires a separate block."}
